content: The Go-Explore based exploration algorithm sees less of a difference between agents. A2C-Explore converges more quickly, but to a lower reward trajectory that fails to pass the bottleneck, whereas KG-A2C-Explore takes longer to reach a similar reward but consistently makes it through the bottleneck. The knowledge graph cell representation appears to thus be a better indication of what a promising state is as opposed to just the textual observation.
